summary: Phase 1 Inventory accepted at HEAD 3e8d29e890aebd564ef3d01cb31b13f776d8d814. HEAD equals the audited SHA. The phase diff db2053f2..3e8d29e8 touches only phase-owned paths: the checker, the red and green logs, the adversarial artifacts, the Phase 1 lines of plan.md, and scenes/inventory.md. The TSV and docs/map-review.html are unchanged in the range. Both gates were rerun live and pass: check-inventory.sh exits 0 with 9 checks (PASS=9, FAIL=0), and adversarial-p1.sh exits 0 with the control OK and all eight probes CAUGHT. Every plan claim was re-verified against command output, including the Red exit 1 in red-p1.log. An independent awk comparison of all 30 inventory rows against the final bench/sonnet/log.tsv rows agrees 30 of 30. Reviews A and C at feeca3f3 still cover Phase 1: the only commits after feeca3f3 (0355d23c, 54213a00, 3e8d29e8) touch only measure/runs/ test artifacts, the inventory and plan are byte-identical at HEAD, and the one changed test file (check-inventory.sh, 54213a00) is the remediation of the review nits, verified by the adversarial PASS at 54213a00 and by this acceptance's own live gate reruns. The UX browser review does not apply to Phase 1: the phase diff touches no shot, scene source, mockup, page, or app path, and the strategy assigns the visual look of the 30 shots to the Phase 2 judge. One Nit carries forward from the adversarial record: the checker pins the expected MAPS values instead of parsing the live log, so a later log edit would drift unnoticed.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] phase-acceptance (carried from adversarial ADV-5, no action for Phase 1): check-inventory.sh pins the expected MAPS ratings, notes, and maker family inside maps_expected (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-inventory.sh:37-71) instead of parsing bench/sonnet/log.tsv live. The pinned table equals the live log today (this audit compared all 30 rows: 30 of 30 agree). The exposure is a later edit of the log or of docs/map-review.html that the gate would not notice. A later phase that regenerates the log or the page must re-diff the pinned table against the live file.

A5 plan-claim verification: every claim in plan.md lines 14, 19, and 31 to 33 was re-verified. Red exited 1 before the inventory existed (red-p1.log lines 6 to 10, commit 8e20f73d). 30 rows exist; the checker's P1-b proves all 150 named paths exist (30 x 5); every row holds MAPS rating 7.0, a source note, judge: no, maker: Anthropic Sonnet, and state inventoried; no row is missing. The e964238a fixes named in the plan are present in the committed checker (A9 case test at lines 226 to 230, state-cell awk parse).

Independent MAPS fidelity check: an awk loop took the final bench/sonnet/log.tsv row per civic slug (score field 11, note field 13, empty note recorded as none recorded) and compared all 30 rows with the inventory cells. Output: no mismatch line; 30 of 30 agree. This confirms the record independently of the checker's pinned table.

Review currency decision: Reviews A and C at feeca3f3 still cover Phase 1 and must not run again. Reason: the implementation content of the phase (scenes/inventory.md at db233e01, plan.md evidence lines at f0224d36 and 2e8e4f01) is byte-identical at HEAD; every commit after feeca3f3 (0355d23c, 54213a00, 3e8d29e8) touches only test files under measure/runs/; and the one reviewed test file that changed (check-inventory.sh at 54213a00) is the remediation of the review nits, covered by the adversarial re-audit PASS at 54213a00 (adversarial-54213a0.json) and by this acceptance's live reruns of both gates. The acceptance records the exact HEAD 3e8d29e8 and the allowed test-only commits 0355d23c, 54213a00, 3e8d29e8.

UX browser review decision: not applicable to Phase 1. The phase diff adds records only and touches no shot, scene source, mockup JPG, page, route, or app path; the 30 shots are inputs that Phase 1 does not modify, so a browser look can falsify no Phase 1 claim. test-strategy.md section 9 ties the judge rating and the human look at the images to Phase 2 and Phase 3 closing, and section 10 routes the visual look of the 30 shots to the Phase 2 judge. Review C recorded the same decision (ux_applicability: not_applicable). The browser review becomes due when Phase 2 rates the shots or Phase 3 produces fresh rework shots.

A3 and A4: the checker counts rows with a labeled line count (grep -c 'scenes/maps/') compared by integer arithmetic (-eq 30 and -ge 1), not a bare digit match; a date or stray digit cannot satisfy it. An absent or empty inventory fails P1-a (red-p1.log exit 1), so the pass is not vacuous. The phase has 2 completed [x] tasks, so the markers are real.

A6 and A7: the registry entry in measure/tracks.md at 3e8d29e8 reads [~] Track: Plan and accept civic scenes, and plan.md status reads in_progress; no completion claim exists for a phase that is only now accepted. The slug set comes from all 30 civic P2 rows of the TSV via awk ($2==civic && $3==P2); no filter drops a slug and no banned-term filter masks a hit.

Adversarial chain: adversarial-feeca3f.json records status fail with one Blocker (ADV-1) and three Nits; the fix 54213a00 changed only check-inventory.sh and red-p1.log; adversarial-54213a0.json records status pass at 54213a00 with every routed finding verified fixed and five new probes pinning the value-check semantics.
Aggregate suites: test-strategy.md section 8 keeps vitest and tsc out of the phase gates for this records-only track; no stale intentional-red aggregate test masks the phase result.
